description:
Sponsored by Zocdoc. Taking care of your health just got easier, start here at: https://zocdoc.com/GoodWork 

The Bond Market. Okay, now that your pants are off, we got a fresh new investigation for you to lay your newly clotheless body on. What is the bond market? What is it telling us? What’s this got to do with debt? And how come I’m the only one pronouncing the “b” in debt? Dan Toomey and the investigative news team answer all this and more in today’s episode. 

Featuring interviews with:

Robin Wigglesworth, Editor of FT Alphaville and author of A Fabulous Debt
Follow Robin here: https://x.com/RobinWigg

title: Will the bond market drag us to hell?
